mapper.insert: INSERT INTO file_jobs ( asset_id, type, status, attempt_count, available_at, dispatch_after, dedup_key, payload, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{job.assetId}, #{job.type}, #{job.status}, COALESCE(#{job.attemptCount}, 0), #{job.availableAt}, #{job.dispatchAfter}, #{job.dedupKey}, #{job.payload,jdbcType=OTHER,typeHandler=com.nep.tsuki.infra.persistence.mybatis.PostgresJsonbTypeHandler}, #{now}, #{now} ) ON CONFLICT (dedup_key) WHERE dedup_key IS NOT NULL AND status IN ('PENDING', 'RUNNING') DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT id, asset_id, type, attempt_count FROM file_jobs WHERE status = 'RUNNING' AND lease_until IS NOT NULL AND lease_until <= #{now} ORDER BY lease_until, id LIMIT #{batchSize} FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
mapper.update: UPDATE file_jobs SET status = 'PENDING', available_at = #{nextAvailableAt}, dispatch_after = #{nextAvailableAt}, lease_until = NULL, dispatch_token = NULL, dispatched_at = NULL, failure_code = #{failureCode}, failure_message = #{failureMessage}, updated_at = #{now} WHERE id = #{jobId} AND status = 'RUNNING' AND attempt_count = #{expectedAttemptCount} AND lease_until > #{now}
